doc.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024

title: Liberals, conservatives and the American left
summary: His view that liberals are now the new conservatives and that America has no real left.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: I want — one more thing — I want —

Okay as of this election cycle Liberals with a capital L are the new conservatives, with a small C because conservatives are radicals. Liberals believe in constitutionality, the rule of law, old fashioned values. Trump supporters — MAGA Republicans are radicals who would overthrow that order and we saw that. That’s not an empty allegation, we saw that on January 6. And to kind of spy on the enemy I’ve kind of listened to Sean Hannity a couple of times and people like that, and read some things, and they keep shouting about the left. Looking at it from overseas I do not perceive a “Left” with a capital L. There is no Left in America. There is no consolidated Left opposition and certainly not a capital L

left. I think what they may mean, or try to make us believe applies to Democrats and green-carded people and so forth, are a kind of equally illiberal, woke group that would impose censorship on speech that they don’t agree with. And again, that is not liberal, that is not left, that is just a different kind of authoritarianism. So I think you’re bemused by my observation but just take it as my opinion as American has no left as such. It has opposed authoritarian groupings and that liberals, which I take you to be, are people who — of a certain age kind of took for granted the kind of life we had under Clinton and Obama and we knew there were bad guys out there but maybe not so bad. You know George Bush was just dumb but you know not evil. You could see some humanity there, but now it’s polarized and toxic. On that black note I guess we’re wound up.
